smartmeter.name: WattWise
smartmeter.stack: STM32, ESP32, FreeRTOS, C, MQTT, KiCad

bullets.text: Built a single-phase energy meter that reports consumption per appliance circuit, because a monthly bill cannot show which appliance wastes power.
Calibrated current and voltage sensing to within 1.5% of a reference meter across five test loads, from phone chargers to a water heater.
Published readings over MQTT every ten seconds through an ESP32 Wi-Fi bridge, keeping the metering MCU free of network code.
Split the firmware into FreeRTOS sampling and communication tasks so a slow network never delays a measurement window.
Built battery-powered soil-moisture nodes for a two-acre farm plot, so irrigation follows measured moisture instead of a fixed timetable.
Reached 1.2 km line-of-sight range and about nine months of battery life on two AA cells using duty-cycled deep sleep.
Designed the node PCB in KiCad over two revisions, moving the antenna feed away from the regulator to fix packet loss.
Cut pump running time by about 30% over one season once irrigation was scheduled from the sensor readings.

bullets.text: Built a line-following robot for the college robotics contest, finishing the track in 14.2 seconds and placing third of 42 teams.
Tuned the PID gains from logged sensor error streamed over UART, removing the oscillation that threw early builds off sharp curves.
